The entire grid is a \(4\times 4\) square, so its area is

\[
4\cdot 4=16.
\]

The shaded polygon excludes two congruent right triangles on the right. Each triangle has legs of length \(2\), so each has area

\[
\frac12(2)(2)=2.
\]

Therefore, the shaded area is

\[
16-2-2=12.
\]
